text:
maya: FYI our nightly SAST on prod started failing with KMS decrypt errors after yesterday's RBAC cleanup.
rik: saw the alerts. looks like the scanner role lost the 'env:prod' principal tag that our key policy checks for.
scanner-bot: alert: job=ci-sast-prod id=job-721 status=FAILED reason=KMSAccessDenied resource=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/fe12-34ab
evan: who rolled the RBAC? I can revert if needed.
maya: rik did a narrow of scanner roles to reduce blast radius last night. probably accidentally removed prod mapping.
rik: confirmed, I tightened bindings and didn't include the prod assume-role mapping. I'll open a revert PR.
audit-bot: log: iam.change by rik at 2026-03-22T12:08:09Z change_id=chg-881 target=role/ci-sast-runner details="removed: roleMapping:prod"
maya: short-term: revert then run 3 failing jobs. long-term: move away from tag-only KMS conditions, or at least add CI preflight that asserts tags.
evan: agreed. I'll add a KMS preflight check to the SAST workflow that fails fast with a clear remediation link.
rik: revert PR opened (PR#4879), rolling now. will also add an RFC for ephemeral scanner roles with explicit key ARNs.
maya: ticket SECU-2026 created to track postmortem & audit improvements. please add CloudTrail evidence to the ticket after revert.
audit-bot: incident: SECU-2026 created owners=[maya,rik,evan]
evan: prod scans back to green after revert. leaving follow-ups: CI preflight, runbook note on key policy changes, and an automated alert when a role loses expected tags.
maya: thanks team. let's capture timeline and root cause in the postmortem.
